params.prompt: One single continuous camera shot, no cuts, photoreal like a real film shot on a handmade miniature model set with macro tilt-shift lenses; natural realistic colours, warm evening practical lights. 0-2s: a young woman dentist in a white coat places a small white architectural model of her dental clinic on the dark wooden table; the man with platinum hair and beard in a white t-shirt and charcoal overshirt leans in to look. 2-4s: without a cut the camera dives down into the model: now we are at miniature scale on a quiet night street, the clinic is dark and empty, tiny hooded agent figures with small head lamps walk in carrying ladders and light boxes. 4-6s: the camera rises and pulls back to a frontal wide view of the whole diorama on the table (exactly the composition of the dark reference frame) and from this moment the camera is completely LOCKED-OFF and STATIC until the end. 6-7.5s: the clinic shop window lights up as a bright website-like display. 7.5-9s: the street light-box poster with a smiling patient lights up. 9-10.5s: the rooftop billboard lights up. 10.5-12s: at the reception inside the tiny phone glows and rings with small light rings. 12-15s: a tiny concierge appears at the door and greets people, tiny patients walk along the street and enter, a queue forms, the small cash register at the reception glows warmly with a few gold coins; the frame ends exactly on the end image. Each element lights up clearly one after another, never all at once. Smooth motion, no text, no letters, no logos.
